items.question: How can a mind fixed on that remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be undergoing severance at a given time.
A mind directed to that object differs from the body being cut.
That directedness can prevent the cutting from affecting the mind.
items.inference: When the mind is fixed on that, severance of the body does not reach or cut the mind.
uncertainties: Extent to which 'that' is determined by prior context remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that is not cut when being cut, severance does not affect such a mind.
